ModMetaData.name: Puffmite Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns' BMT_FleeceSpider art and label/description (all facings - this donor has no dessicated-corpse variant to preserve) per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: non-SW names are free to be reimagined (general kind fixed, specific name/character not). BMT_FleeceSpider is reimagined as **Puffmite**, a filament-tufted, crystalline/bioluminescent tiny arachnid - not a literal fleece spider. Full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
defName is NOT renamed (donor mod's def, not ours - see GritheArtOverride for the same reasoning). loose Textures/ at the same relative path (BMT_Caverns/Things/Animal/FleeceSpider/FleeceSpider_<facing>) the donor uses, plus a small Patches/ pass renaming the label/description on both the ThingDef and the PawnKindDef.
